title: MMDA: Pasig River ferry limits operations on Nov. 17-18

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Pasig River Ferry Service will operate on a limited schedule on November 17-18 for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits, the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said Tuesday. “Trips are scheduled from Pinagbuhatan to Guadalupe and Guadalupe to PUP station only,” MMDA’s Pasig River Ferry Service said in an advisory.
